Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 1, Verse 40

“With the destruction of a family, its eternal traditions perish; and when tradition is lost, lawlessness overwhelms the whole family.”

Arjuna's grief widens here from people to institutions. What worries him is not only who dies today but the slow unravelling that follows, which no one will be left to notice.
